integrity: The complete Reynolds defect is reconstructed on every ordered basis triple and solved by a two-case polynomial argument. Finite-field enumeration over four odd prime fields independently checks the classification, point counts, and rank distribution.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the two-dimensional nonabelian Lie triple system and Reynolds weight -1.
The theorem does not classify all Reynolds weights simultaneously.
title: Reynolds operators on the minimal nonabelian Lie triple system
